actualSourceEncoding.samplingPolicy: For sample n at source n/25 seconds, use the last accepted genuine CDP frame whose actual source timestamp is <= n/25. First eligible sample for each frame is ceil(actualSourceSeconds*25). Equal-grid later frames replace earlier accepted frames only at that shared grid point; zero-sample records remain in the original manifest. No future frame is used and actual counters/clock are not rewritten.
actualSourceEncoding.staticIntervals: Actual unchanged CDP frames are held only across elapsed source-clock intervals. Live start/end DOM observations and the actual stop clock are retained. No generated browser pixels, planned phase substitution or cross-take state is used.
actualSourceEncoding.durationQuantizationExplanation: Container duration is the ceil stop-time 25 fps grid; the final sample timestamp is still before the observed live stop. A fractional final frame interval can extend less than 1/25 second beyond stop, not a claim of additional live observation.
